plan.text: After one year of service, Chipotle employees can buy company stock each quarter at 92.5% of the market price through the employee stock purchase plan.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Note 8 Stock-Based Compensation and Employee Benefit Plans
source.quote: Employees become eligible to participate in the program after one year of service with Chipotle and may contribute up to 15 % of their earnings, subject to an annual maximum dollar amount. The ESPP provides a quarterly offering period to purchase our common stock at a price of 92.5 % of the lower of the fair market value on the first and last trading days of each offering period.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001058090-26-000009), reported in thousands and converted to billions; they match SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001140361-26-017294), percentages based on 1,285,398,159 shares outstanding on April 15, 2026. LEADER: Brian Niccol, former Chairman and CEO, left in August 2024; Scott Boatwright is CEO. The 2026 proxy names Niccol only as former CEO in the pay-versus-performance table and does not list him in the beneficial ownership table, so status is no-reported-stake. HOLDERS: Vanguard's 11.25% rests on a Schedule 13G/A filed January 7, 2026 (no as-of date given, so asOf is the filing date); the proxy adds that a later Vanguard 13G/A (March 26, 2026) reported zero shares as of January 12, 2026 after an internal reorganization disaggregated its holdings, with its subsidiaries reporting separately, so the 11.25% is the last aggregate figure, not current. Capital World Investors' 7.92% is as of December 31, 2025. BlackRock no longer appears in the 5% table. GEOGRAPHY: Chipotle reports one reportable segment (U.S.); the other operating segments (Canada, Europe, international partner-operated restaurants) are shown as 'All other revenue' in the reconciliation. BUYBACKS exclude $49 million of tax withholding on stock-based compensation awards.
